notes.title: Everholm Major Update 1.1.0 is here!!
notes.notes:
✨ Hey everyone! ✨   

We are very excited for this update and for more to come! 🎉  
We listened to your feedback and decided to separate the most wanted features and suggestions into a few Major Updates!

🛠️ 1.1.0 Changes & New Content!  


 📜 Quests Overhauled! – Quests are now way more achievable and rewarding! No more impossible fetch quests!  We made a whole system to track your in-game progress and based on that some Everfolk will give out quests that make sense for your current abilities! 

🍀 Luck Adjusted! – No more bad luck streaks! The system has been improved to prevent repeated unlucky days. This way the game should feel much more relaxed! We are also thinking of ways to add mini games that would be better played on bad luck days so you guys would have something fun to do on bad luck days!

🍳 Cooking is here! – The kitchen is no longer just for show! You can now cook delicious recipes to aid you in your adventures! We’ve added 50 recipes for you to discover, with more on the way! 

📖 Compendium Added! – Track your discoveries, learn about sell & buy values of each item, track how you got it, and more! Great for completionists!  


🐛 Bug Fixes! – Issues resolved and adjusted:


   ❄️ Fixed ghost-feeding freeze  
   ⚔️ Zoe dialogue - freeze
   🐔 Animals get out of their housing properly!
   🐝 Calendar can be opened by clicking on the date!
   💩 White poop now actually speeds up plant growth by 40%!
  

 Why Check It Out?  

This update makes Everholm’s gameplay feel so much more rewarding! 🌿✨  
If you’ve played before, now’s the time to dive back in and see the improvements!  

 Future plans!
Another Major Update is on the way!! ✨  

 New fun quests!
 The Archive...
 Localization system (Chinese first, more to come!)
 Story improvements
 Npc dialogues with big portraits and emotions
 Achievements
 Cutscenes


💬 Let Us Know What You Think!   

Your feedback is invaluable to us! 💖  
We are always available to you on Discord or here in the Steam Discussions for any issues, suggestions or questions! 🏡  

We hope you love the update and enjoy the game! 🌿✨  

Chonky Loaf Team 💜

notes.title: Update 1.0.12
notes.notes:
✨ 1.0.12 ✨

🪲 Bugs 🪲

 Fixed a collision bug in the upgraded house kitchen.
 Fixed an issue where Mana, Energy, and Health would not reset to their max value when loading.
 Fixed the Watering Can not saving its water level and resetting when stored in a chest.
 Fixed music restarting at the beginning of every underworld level. Now it will continue smoothly unless entering a new biome.
 Fixed Jungle Biome floating island issue
 Fixed Hannah Shop missing upgrades
 Fixed Animals not getting out of their Barn or Coop sometimes


🪴 Adjustments 🪴

 Increased drop chance for grass, stone and other obstacles
 Seeding plants now works with Aim-Assist on controllers
 Removed Resolution Restriction: You can now set any resolution while in windowed mode!
 A Ton of Typo Fixes
 Spell Summon rocks are now saved and we restricted spawn locations to only on surface of Everholm
 Broom Helper now has a fixed 9x9 range
 Building Interior and Exterior mixup bug fixed
 Fixed Workbench crafting an item with magic chest and full inventory would result in a lost crafted item
 Fly Grub Enemy Hex form fixed
 Various performance fixes


📰 News 📰

 Regional prices have been adjusted!
 We're working on some very exciting updates!


📝 Notes 📝
Split Stack in chests and shipping container is unfortunately still causing issues and we're working hard on fixing it so it's stable to use.
The main issue with it is that it may cause items to disappear and we can't have that happening so we disabled it until we're sure that something like that won't happen.
You can split stacks in your backpack until we get it fixed!

Have a great day! 💜
Chonky Loaf Team

Until then, 
Chonky Loaf Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Here's what we've been working on: 

 Steam Cloud Save! ☁️ 

This was requested by many people and it's our job to listen! 
Steam cloud save is fully integrated and tested, works on Steam Deck too! 

Windowed mode that works well! 🪟

Requested by streamers, people with Ultra Wide monitors and other window mode lovers!

 Zoom in and out! 🔎   

There's only a few levels currently, but it will be useful until we figure out how to do some finer zoom adjustments.

Text in Cutscenes does not auto scroll anymore! ⏳   

Once the typewriter effect is done, your input is required to continue the cutscene, this way all of the text will be easily readable and you won't miss a thing!

Fishing minigame toggle! 🎣   

Simply open up your settings and turn off the Fishing minigame! Simple as that!
You will still have to upgrade your fishing rod to get all of the fish though!

Dropped items are saved! 💾   

Anything dropped on the surface of Everholm will be saved. ( wild animal loot, rewards, anything really )

Changes ✏️

 Fiona house is not so dark anymore
 Night time in Fall is brighter
 No Npc friendship decay
 Npc tracking by default with 0 hearts needed
 Rain doesn't affect the interiors
 Rain doesn't fall on festivals
 Rain falls less in spring and summer
 Disliked gifts have less of an impact
 Loved gifts bring more points
 Added Pond and Lake on the map
 Added Light in the Home interior fireplace
 Animals are way less needy
 Each Animal eats only 1 food from the feeder
 Bee house reworked and balanced
 Cauldron Festival gives very valuable rewards depending on the amount of stars you get
 Added a better description of how the Cauldron mini-game works
 Barn and Coop are much smaller in size and take a lot less tiles
 Fruit trees are sold at Marry's shop in winter
 Added text to Trinket descriptions : “Place it in your backpack [ring/necklace/etc] slot”
 Adjusted Field Frenzy, Rain Cloud, Swift sprout to be cheaper but also take more energy and mana
 Shadow tools require a Star Gem now
 Maple and Paul interior changed camera to follow player to a degree
 Easter Race rewards can now be sold
 Flowers are harvested only with scythe ( easier honey harvesting )
 Mayo , Cheese machines fuel changes and ratio
 Vine Rope drop buffed
 Marry's shop items now go up to 999 items per day
 Added [Multi harvest] and [Harvestable with scythe] in descriptions of seeds (with a different color)
 Spinach seeds adjusted

Bugs 🐞

 Collision traps (for all collisions)
 Ghosts caused a crash when talking to them
 Boss fight caused a crash
 Animals reset when max hearts bug fixed
 Having exactly 9 health when using fishing rod would freeze the game
 Machines could change their already smelted (refined) product in certain situations
 Not getting items when inventory full ( these items will drop on the map and be saved waiting for you now )
 Ghosts caused a freeze in other UIs
 Some players couldn't use the Greenhouse key
 Optimized bees
 Underworld trees are now affected by Axe strength
 Bounds collision was missing in one of the dreams

Dash of New content 🌷

 Orchidium Sprinklers
 Firefly ring added (trinket) 
 Eclipse locket added(trinket)


Items on our Most Wanted List: 🚧 

Optimization:

Improve Performance
Get rid of Stutters

Gameplay:

Pacing of the early game 
More early game tutorials
Making quests smart ( so they wouldn't ask for late game items in the beginning ) 
More minigames
Half body profile pictures with a classic bottom dialogue box
Npc's with emotions and brand new improved dialogues
Late game automations

Features:

Steam Deck full support
Increase Font size across all UI's
Localization system 

Controller:

Fixing the controller interaction issue : Smart Auto Tool use on the controller -> 
example: you won't have to exactly select the unwatered tile to water it, if your near enough it will look for any unwatered tile, turn to it and water it. This applies to all tools and interactable objects. 


Our roadmap will go public soon! 🚗  

It includes years worth of free updates, including: content, music, npcs, house expansions, compendiums, Collectors Gallery, new islands, boat travel, deep sea fishing, and so much more! - Stay tuned! 

Thank you all for being here with us and giving us this incredibly helpful feedback!
Chonky Loaf Team
